description: Bundled GPL instruments built from source as separate VST3 plugins: Vitalium (a renamed Vital build), Dexed and OB-Xf. They run out of process in daw's plugin worker and are never linked into daw.
license: GPL-3.0-or-later (each instrument keeps its own licence; see licenses/ in the pack)

instruments.name: Vitalium

upstream.based_on: https://github.com/mtytel/vital (GPL-3.0; 'Vital' is a trademark of Matt Tytel, so the build is renamed)

presets.provenance: No factory presets ship: DISTRHO's Vitalium port has none, and Vital's own factory presets are not free. Load your own .vital files with --preset FILE.vital.

banks.name: Vital factory presets
banks.source: not in the GPL source (distributed by Vital Audio with its own installer)
banks.license: proprietary; not covered by Vital's GPL-3.0 source licence
banks.reason: Not free and not part of the source: excluded.

instruments.summary: Spectral-warping wavetable synth: 3 wavetable oscillators, sample oscillator, 2 filters, drag-and-drop modulation. Patches are JSON (.vital).

instruments.name: Dexed

presets.provenance: No DX7 cartridges ship. Dexed's built-in banks (Dexed_01 and SynprezFM_01-32, in assets/builtin_pgm.zip) are compilations of voices from DX7 SysEx archives with no per-voice authors and no stated terms, so the recipe replaces that zip with a Dexed_01.syx of 32 copies of Dexed's own INIT VOICE (from its GPL source) before building; the binary and the source archive carry no third-party voices. Load your own cartridges in Dexed.

banks.name: Dexed_01
banks.source: assets/builtin_pgm.zip: Dexed_01.syx (32 voices; Dexed's startup cartridge)
authors: unknown (compiled by Jean-Marc Desprez from DX7 voice archives)
banks.license: none stated; in Dexed's GPL-3.0 repository, but no licence from the voices' authors is known
banks.reason: Unknown authors and no redistribution terms: excluded, and removed from the Dexed build.

banks.name: SynprezFM_01 to SynprezFM_32
authors: unknown per voice (selected by Jean-Marc Desprez from about 22,000 patches circulating online; Dexed's README credits the compilation, not the sounds)
banks.reason: Unknown authors and no redistribution terms; such archives can include voices from Yamaha or commercial cartridges: excluded, and removed from the Dexed build.

banks.name: Yamaha DX7 ROM and voice cartridges (ROM1A-4B, VRC)

instruments.summary: DX7 FM synth (6 operators, 32 algorithms), modelled on the original's envelopes and DAC; loads DX7 SysEx cartridges.

instruments.name: OB-Xf

presets.provenance: OB-Xf's own factory library (.fxp, in its source tree's installer assets; not embedded in the plugin). Each patch declares its author and licence inside it; only patches marked CC0 ship, each with its author recorded in the preset index.

banks.name: OB-Xf factory library
banks.source: assets/installer/Surge Synth Team/OB-Xf/Patches (487 of 488 .fxp at v1.0.3)
banks.license: CC0 (each patch declares license="CC0" or "CC0 / Public Domain")
banks.reason: Made for OB-Xf by the named authors (OB-Xd patches are not compatible) and dedicated to the public domain in each file.

banks.name: Bells/Singing Noise
banks.reason: The one patch with no author or licence in it: excluded (the index rejects any patch not marked CC0).

instruments.summary: Oberheim OB-X/OB-Xa-style 8-voice analog polysynth (continuation of OB-Xd): 2 oscillators, 2/4-pole filter, voice variation.
